body.p: Earlier there was a man, he had a wife, he had five children. He left his children in the tent, he went off with the woman, they went for wood. When they had gone, a tramp came into their tent. He killed the man's children. The tramp chopped the children's heads off, having chopped he wrapped [them] into the blanket. The old man came home, his children are not at home. The old man unwrapped the blanket, there the children's heads are lying. The old man startled, there he choked, he died.
